description.value: A few changes to their design leave your pawns with some room to spare. A pawn with this Schematic installed can store up to 2 light Bulk of items in an empty compartment inside its body, though none of these items can be longer than 1 foot in any dimension. Anyone can place an item in the compartment or retrieve one from it with a single Interact action. Opening or closing the compartment's door is part of that Interact action.
